people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
translations.bsb: who sent His glorious arm to lead them by the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown,
translations.kjv: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
translations.asv: that caused his glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses? that divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
